## Adopt the fleet-bus C6 contract (OB adopter side)

fleet-bus now makes **[C6 — Envelope vs. Message Body](https://github.com/rodaddy/fleet-bus/blob/main/docs/contracts/C6-envelope-vs-message-body.md)** the code-enforced default: coordination (completion, stance, liveness, routing) rides **typed envelope fields** (`typed_signal` + the known wire keys); the message body (`payload`) is **opaque to the bus** — free for a receiver to use, but never a coordination signal, and control-looking body text is inert.

**Ask:** audit wherever OB touches the fleet bus and bring it into compliance for whichever role(s) apply.

### Required

- **As a consumer:** derive completion/stance/routing from the **typed envelope** (`typed_signal`, routing keys), never by scraping `payload` or reply text. The `[[done]]`/`[[stance]]` trailer path is gone (fleet-bus #205/#209).
- **As a producer** (if OB publishes coordination): emit typed **`Done`/`Stance`** on `typed_signal`, keep OB-specific data in `payload` as opaque body — never expect the bus to act on a body key.

### Acceptance

- OB's bus paths read/write coordination through the typed envelope; `payload` is used only as opaque receiver data, documented as such.

### References

- C6 contract: https://github.com/rodaddy/fleet-bus/blob/main/docs/contracts/C6-envelope-vs-message-body.md
- fleet-bus #205 / #209 (trailer removal).

## Discussion (1)

### rodaddy — 2026-07-22T01:38:28Z

Closing: the C6 audit is complete and Open Brain is conformant. Verified against main (7aa529a):

- **Consumer path:** `src/nats-bridge.ts` (~L272-286) parses the fleet envelope and hard-rejects any inbound envelope whose typed `kind` is not `context_pack_request` **before** touching payload — dispatch is envelope-typed; payload is opaque request data only. No reply/loop poisoning path.
- **No body-scraped coordination anywhere:** grep for `[[done]]`/`[[stance]]`/payload-derived completion across `src/` and `python/` is empty; OB never consumed the removed fleet-bus trailer path.
- **Producer path:** OB emits only typed request/reply envelopes (`context_pack_response` with body/payload as opaque receiver data); it has no Done/Stance emission at all.
- **Wire parity:** `python/openbrain-memory/src/openbrain_memory/nats_wire.py` reuses `fleet_nats.Envelope` when importable (byte-for-byte parity probed 2026-07-08) with a 1:1 mirror fallback (PRs #284/#285).
- **Documented:** `docs/GLOSSARY.md` (via #292) states the exact C6 split — envelope = transport, body opaque to the bus, OB contract rides in the data slot — linking the fleet-bus C6 doc; `docs/fleet-nats-integration.md` covers the adoption.

One conformant nuance for the record: the bridge reads `payload.namespace` as receiver-local data (lane override) — C6 explicitly permits receiver-side use of the opaque body; it is gated by `OPENBRAIN_NATS_ALLOW_NAMESPACE_OVERRIDE` with the documented cross-tenant precondition.
